overview.overviewText: This chapter explores Stoichiometric Calculations: Mole-Mole and Volume-Volume Relations, providing comprehensive conceptual analysis, mathematical relationships, and structured applications grounded in NCERT authority.

blocks.title: 1. Key Academic Principles: Stoichiometric Calculations: Mole-Mole and Volume-Volume Relations
blocks.contentMarkdown: Stoichiometry deals with calculations of masses, moles, and volumes of reactants and products involved in a chemical reaction.

blocks.title: 2. Key Academic Principles: Stoichiometric Calculations: Mole-Mole and Volume-Volume Relations
blocks.contentMarkdown: In N2(g) + 3 H2(g) -> 2 NH3(g), 1 mole of N2 (28 g, 22.7 L at STP) reacts with 3 moles of H2 (6 g, 68.1 L at STP) to produce 2 moles of NH3 (34 g, 45.4 L at STP).
